question: Should `openclaw claws export` become part of the core Claws lifecycle stack in this shape, or should export wait until the lower lifecycle PRs settle or be narrowed before first release?
rationale: The patch is not a narrow bug fix; it creates a new public CLI authoring path whose contract depends on the unmerged Claws lifecycle stack and maintainer product direction.

options.title: Review with the Claws stack
options.body: Keep this PR open and review it after the base lifecycle PRs settle so export/apply/status/remove share one accepted manifest contract.

options.title: Accept the export surface now
options.body: Proceed with this command shape as part of the core Claws launch, accepting the new CLI/API surface once proof and stack checks are complete.

options.title: Defer or narrow export
options.body: Ask the branch to reduce supported selectors or wait for a later Claws authoring milestone if maintainers are not ready to commit to export semantics.

recommendation.title: Review with the Claws stack
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and review it after the base lifecycle PRs settle so export/apply/status/remove share one accepted manifest contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Claws stack and are the clearest owner for revising this export surface against the rest of the lifecycle sequence.
